# Reusable workflow contract

> The triggers, `workflow_call` inputs and secrets, job permissions, timeouts and concurrency of every `claude*.yml` workflow, generated from the workflow files.

What each workflow does, and the gates behind each trigger, is explained in [docs/workflows.md](../workflows.md). Everything listed here is public API: add, don't rename. A caller passes `secrets: inherit` and grants its job at least the permissions below, because a reusable workflow cannot exceed its caller's grants.

## `claude-auto-merge.yml` — Claude Auto-Merge

Call it as `uses: bamr87/githubai/.github/workflows/claude-auto-merge.yml@main`.

**Triggers:** `pull_request` (opened, labeled) · `workflow_dispatch` · `workflow_call`

**`workflow_call` inputs:**

| Input | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pr_number` | string | no | — | PR number to evaluate; defaults to the triggering PR |
| `config_path` | string | no | `.github/githubai.yml` | Path to the repo's githubai.yml |

**`workflow_dispatch` inputs:**

| Input | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pr_number` | string | yes | — | Pull request number to evaluate |

**Secrets:**

| Secret | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | no | Claude Code OAuth token from `claude setup-token` (preferred) |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | no | Anthropic API key, used only when no OAuth token is set |

**Jobs:**

| Job | Permissions | Timeout (min) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `evaluate` | `actions: read`, `checks: read`, `contents: write`, `id-token: write`, `issues: read`, `pull-requests: write` | 20 |

**Concurrency:** group `claude-auto-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.pr_number || github.run_id }}`; cancel in progress: yes.
